checks.details: The actual invoked evaluator takes identity/camera/scene labels from protocol records. RGBNT201/RGBNT100 remove same-identity same-camera gallery items; MSVR310 removes same-identity same-scene items. AP averages precision at all remaining true-match positions; CMC uses first true-match rank. The pipeline calls the author-source evaluator and asserts agreement within 1e-5. Saved-query counts are 836, 591, 1715 and source-declared full-gallery counts are 836, 1055, 8575. No model-derived GT is used in this path. This auditor did not receive/re-authenticate the raw benchmark annotations, protocol row files or remote distance tensors; real-GT provenance is source-level, not independent raw-data recertification.

No metric is divided by the model output maximum/minimum/mean. AP uses the number of GT positives; macro mAP/CMC divide by legal query count and multiply by 100. Feature L2 normalization belongs to the distance definition, not score inflation. Recomputed all 12 saved-query pair metrics, AP sign counts at the existing 1e-8 threshold, per-identity deltas, repair/harm counts, four AP contribution groups and worst ceil(5%*N) tails. Official float32 CMC differs from integer-count percentages by at most 2.9541660637733003e-06 percentage points, inside the existing source tolerance of 1e-5; this is not a relaxed threshold.

All three manifests match all 59 extracted files (30+11+18); sixth ZIP matches its 2,554,519-byte metadata hash and all 18 members plus manifest. All six summaries agree with original training and strict metric receipts. Each contains epochs1..50, seed42, and the max-mAP/latest-tie selected epoch (8/8, 38/38, 26/26) with that same epoch CMC.
